reply_text:
I told Dana in a #north-team thread that the seat count for Quarrendon Freight Lines' 2026 renewal is 261. That's the figure Ilse posted in that channel on Oct 14.

I couldn't check it against the signed renewal because there's no Quarrendon contract in the files Dana can see. The only renewal record there is the North digest from March 23. It says the renewal was signed on 2026-03-20 by Ilse (acting) and Thea Ramaswell, but it gives no seat count.

In the same reply I pointed out that the 185 seats posted in August 2025 is the Amendment No. 1 count, not the renewal. I also suggested she ask June or Ilse for the signed copy if the tracker needs the number confirmed.

I only used what Dana can see herself: #north-team and public files. Seat counts aren't finance figures, so no approval was needed.
